messages:
alex: quick follow-up from the postmortem thread - three repeat patterns we saw: silent config drift, overly fast ramps, and missing circuit-breakers. I'd like to operationalize fixes into a policy + lightweight enforcement in rollout-service.

maria: +1. can we target rollout-service flags for v1? keeps scope small.

jin: sg. proposal sketch: policy with auto_rollback=true, conditions like error_rate>3% or p95>900ms, and default blast_radius=10%.

samir: tagging infra/oncall - @ops-bot can we make sure rollbacks create a tracking event in incidents so handoffs show up? we also need to record the triggering metric snapshot.

ops-bot: logged INF-5030: emit rollback.events to incident timeline and attach rollback.trigger_metrics tag.

alex: ownership idea: maria owns rollout-service policy integration (10d), jin owns telemetry + alerting (5d), elaine updates runbooks and post-rollback verification (2d). samir to sign off infra impacts (paging/quota).

elaine: i'll draft a short runbook section: preconditions, what the auto-rollback does, how to override, and minimal validation after rollback.

maria: early config draft for rollout-service API below. will open PR after feedback.

``` 
# rollout-default-policy.yaml
policy_version: 1
auto_rollback: true
rollback_triggers:
  - metric: error_rate
    operator: '>'
    value: 3
  - metric: p95_latency_ms
    operator: '>'
    value: 900
blast_radius:
  unit: percent
  max: 10
ramp_steps: [0.5, 2, 10]
step_validation_window_seconds: 120
step_checks: ["error_rate","p95_latency_ms"]
alert_channels: ["#incidents","#eng-oncall"]
manual_override: {requires_two_admins: true}
```

jin: i like steps. add step_fail_thresholds so a transient blip doesn't rollback prematurely. maybe require condition sustained for 2 consecutive windows.

samir: agree. also add a cooldown so flags that oscillate don't page repeatedly. filing INF-5031 to track rate-limit on automatic rollbacks.

alex: decision: implement step ramps with automated validation per step, cooldown between rollbacks, and a sheriff-bypass that needs two approvals for emergency fast ramps. need console telemetry per-step.

maria: adding UI hooks to show live metrics per step and a small banner when a flag is under automatic control.

jin: telemetry plan: emit metrics with labels: flag_id, step, region, variant; stream to metrics-store and the rollout dashboard. also send an event to incidents when an auto-rollback occurs with reason and metric snapshot.

samir: infra checklist: confirm alert quota, paging rate-limits, and that rollback actions are idempotent. i'll validate with ops team this week.

deploy-bot: rollout-policy-service v1.4 queued for staging (sha: d4e5f6) by maria.

alex: timeline recap: maria 10d, jin 5d, elaine 2d, samir infra check. weekly check-in Fri to validate canary results. goal: drop manual rollback median from ~18min to <2min and cap default blast radius to 10%.

elaine: adding verification checklist: confirm feature off for target audience, run smoke tests on core flows, validate error-rate and latency back to baseline, then clear incident.

maria: opening draft PR now for early review.

alex: thanks all. please add any blockers to INF-5030/INF-5031 and flag if we need more time. :rocket:
